title: "svelte/no-dupe-on-directives"

Two `on:` directives for the same event with the same handler on one element call the handler twice. An `on:` directive without a handler, which forwards the event, counts as the same as another one without a handler.

{/* Generated by src/codegen/lint-rule-docs.ts. Do not edit this section. */}

## Configure

Off by default. It runs on the Svelte components that an ESLint config lints with `svelte-eslint-parser`, in the place of the rule of `eslint-plugin-svelte`:

{/* skip */}

```js eslint.config.js
import svelte from "eslint-plugin-svelte";

export default [
  ...svelte.configs.recommended,
  { rules: { "svelte/no-dupe-on-directives": "error" } },
];
```

{/* End of the generated section. */}

## Examples

Reported:

{/* bad */}

```svelte
<button on:click={save} on:click={save}>Save</button>
```

Not reported:

{/* good */}

```svelte
<button on:click={save} on:click={track}>Save</button>
```
